SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-06: FHIRPath — §5.5.1 iif, §5.5.2 Boolean Conversion, §5.5.3 Integer Conversion. Test these items: iif(criterion, true-result, otherwise-result), toBoolean(), convertsToBoolean(), toInteger(), convertsToInteger(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.5.1 iif and §5.5.3 Integer Conversion
issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback rewrites numeric string literals inside iif arguments during wrapper normalization. Reproducer: iif('1'.convertsToInteger(), 'T', 'F') returns ['F'] in fallback but ['T'] in native. The spec says iif returns true-result when the Boolean criterion is true, and convertsToInteger uses regex (\+|-)?\d+ for String conversion.
issues.root_cause: FHIRPathEvaluator.compile() applied the no-whitespace quoted Quantity normalization regex globally, including inside ordinary string literals when a later quoted argument let the regex consume across the function call.
issues.resolution: Added string/comment/delimited-identifier aware normalization so no-whitespace quoted Quantity literals are normalized only outside quoted text.
issues.verified_in: FP-06 EXPLORER probe 38/38 native and fallback, test_conversion_parity.py 13 passed, sort/new-functions 118 passed, operator parity 8 passed, full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.5.3 Integer Conversion and §6.8 Operator precedence
issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback evaluates -1.convertsToInteger() as ['DescendingSortMarker(True)'] with fhirpath_is_valid=true, while native returns empty/NULL and invalid. The spec gives dot invocation higher precedence than unary minus, so this parses as -(1.convertsToInteger()) and unary negation cannot apply to the Boolean result.
issues.root_cause: The Python fallback polarity evaluator returned DescendingSortMarker for non-numeric unary minus in all contexts, even though that marker is only meaningful inside sort() criteria.
issues.resolution: Scoped DescendingSortMarker creation to sort() expression evaluation and raised FHIRPathError for non-sort unary signs on non-numeric values.
issues.verified_in: FP-06 EXPLORER probe 38/38 native and fallback, test_conversion_parity.py 13 passed, sort/new-functions 118 passed, operator parity 8 passed, full conformance 2822/2822
